chunks: What was narrated by Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb, from Aḥmad, from al-Ḥusayn, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, concerning:
A man shaves his head, then applies henna to it, and performs wudu (ablution) for salat (prayer). He said: “There is no harm in his wiping his head while the henna is upon it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wipe the head in wudu (ablution) if henna has been applied to it?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about wudu (ablution), specifically wiping the head when henna has been applied after shaving. Imam Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام states that there is no problem with wiping over the head while the henna is on it, indicating permissibility in this case.
